pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.capacity: One estimator or advisor per booking; 2 pours a day at most per crew; the showroom's design table is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Estimates and running a job: crew leads. Finish consults: finish advisors. Sawing, pumping and sealing: subcontractors.
pf.services.nobody_home: Estimates and sealing: nobody needs to be home if the gate or lockbox is set. Pour days: an adult on the booking is reachable by phone.
pf.services.online: No video or phone finish consult: it uses the sample slabs at the showroom
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest job taken, with smaller requests pointed elsewhere (the example takes no pour under 100 square feet).

before_times: What do you want poured or fixed? (driveway, patio, walk, steps, garage floor)
Rough size, length by width, or just a guess
Is there an old slab to take out first?
after_time: Who will sign the contract? Everyone on the deed should be at the estimate visit
Do you own the property or rent? (the owner must sign)
Where can a concrete truck reach? Gates, low wires, a narrow drive
Sprinkler lines, drains or utility lines near the work
Pets at home during the work
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property, or someone with the owner's written OK. A renter's job needs the owner to sign.
studio: Which area, and a rough budget (on the secure page)

stop.words: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: no booking; a new request must say the home was made safe

stop.words: a slab, step or wall giving way, a sinkhole opening, a retaining wall leaning and moving
stop.says: Keep everyone and every car away from it, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

steps_then_go_on.words: water pooling against the house or coming in under a door
steps_then_go_on.says: Shut off the water at the main valve if a pipe broke. Stay away from wet outlets and switches.

steps_then_go_on.words: a lifted slab edge or a broken step that people could trip on
steps_then_go_on.says: Mark it, keep people off it, and we'll look at it first.

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about whether a slab can be poured over, or about a wall's strength or drainage, go to the business's own line

pf.first_steps.before_quote: The estimate visit at the property, with everyone who will sign there
after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one
The utility locate: the crew asks for buried lines to be marked before anyone digs, and the marks stay until the work is done
The permit, pulled by the license holder in the business's name, where the work needs one
The concrete order and color, set once the window ends
prep: Move cars and anything else off the work area
Mark sprinkler heads and lines you know about

studio_prep: Bring photos and rough measurements of the area

pf.visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Showroom: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator measures, marks and photographs; the written quote follows within 3 business days, good for 30 days
pf.visit.changes: A written change order, priced and signed by both, before any changed work. Soft soil, roots, buried tanks or extra thickness are priced this way.
pf.visit.outside_checks: A forms and base check before the pour, and a final check, where the permit requires them
pf.visit.done: The final check where needed, then the walk-through and punch list, then DONE on the last work day; the curing notes go with it
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the consult, with the advisor's notes and the picks saved for the estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: The area, the old slab, cracks, and anything nearby that could be hit (steps, sprinklers, fences)

pf.money.estimate: The example's $89 estimate visit is credited to the job; billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On project work, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone on the deed
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.stages: Each stage is billed only when it's done and any check has passed: the start, the pour, the finish. Never ahead of the work
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the next stage bill
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the crew lead texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: The pattern mock-up session's $55 is credited to the job if Alex signs; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Crew leads (Dario, Ivan): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the finishers and laborers. Finish advisors (Nell, Ravi) at the showroom.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another crew lead may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its crew lead unless Sam moves it

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.final: The final check and any permit sign-off before the last payment
pf.rules.lien_waivers: Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: 1 year on workmanship (the example's). Hairline cracks from normal curing are not a defect; the contract says what is covered.

pf.edges.weather: Rain, frost or extreme heat on pour day: the pour moves, with no fee; the crew lead checks the forecast the day before
pf.edges.supplier_late: The concrete truck or order is late: wait, or move the day, with no fee to the customer
pf.edges.truck_cannot_reach: The truck can't reach the work: the crew lead calls Alex first; a pump or wheelbarrow work goes on a change order
pf.edges.hidden_conditions: Soft soil, roots or a buried tank found at tear-out: a change order before the fix
pf.edges.line_in_the_way: A marked utility line is in the way: the crew plans around it; the start may move a day or two
pf.edges.permit_late: The start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait
pf.edges.color_varies: Concrete color varies a little from the sample and across a pour; the quote says so
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.nobody_home: Estimates and sealing with the gate or lockbox set, with start and end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project): an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts, switches, settings and money paths are the parent's, re-worded for this work: documents, stages, photos, extrawork, firststeps, multiday, banktransfer; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booking is the $89 estimate visit, credited to the job; Dario's written quote; the contract signed by everyone on the deed; $900 to start, $5,400 when the pour is done, $2,700 at the finish (a $9,000 driveway replacement). The $89 keeps the master's numbers true; a free estimate is the owner's choice (pf.money).
B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, photos|deposit|bill (Walkway section replacement, $640 from photos, a $160 deposit). Left out: list paths. Crack repair ($179) and Concrete sealing ($150) are in pf.services, but the master's booking cards name one list service, so a list path would show the wrong name (MASTER).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Finish Studio, a concrete showroom (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|card|counter: a $35 finish consult with Nell, a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee, paid at the showroom desk. The other three: list|none|counter, list|full|none (pattern mock-up session, $55, credited to the job if Alex signs), list|deposit|counter (driveway design package, $140, $40 deposit).
Flow A has no video or phone consult: the finish consult uses the sample slabs at the showroom (the A4-01 video branch is hidden because the fact `video` is not listed).
Own steps: A8-x01 (the finish consult offers the estimate visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the permit and the utility locate go first; a late permit moves the start with no fee; a marked line in the way means re-planning the pour) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (soft soil under the old slab: a change order first, signed by both).
Concrete is poured once and cures: so rain or frost moves the pour day with no fee (pf.edges, and the master's S13-56 for the weather), cars stay off for about a week (pf.first_steps prep, the DONE note), and the truck's reach and the buried lines are asked before the pour (pf.questions, pf.first_steps).
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now (S2-30 'Yes' branch off, no `sentnow` fact), so nobody is on call.
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 (as the parent).
Names: Dario and Ivan are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Nell and Ravi the finish advisors (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 310 Quarry Rd (the company), 62 Pine St (the showroom), 28 Cedar Ct (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (CC-00123, SC-00456, SR-00789).
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown. No state, city or number from one.
keep: color (a real word of this work), the estimate visit (the trade's own word), leak and valve (the master's safety examples), roofing (the work it doesn't do), drain (a real word here).
Rename: the contractor's pairs re-worded for this work (master sentences first, then phrases, then single words); 'cut' and 'hair' words that the master uses for its barbershop are turned into this work's words or removed (S1-38, S1-60, S13-55, B8-34).
